_comment: The Last Tide has TWO places, each with its own sync root: studio_lobby/ = 'The Last Tide Lobby' (91870148721134, start place) and studio_game/ = 'The Last Tide Game' (100885379547959). LAYOUT IS FLAT: service folders sit directly at the sync root, and StarterPlayer's children are StarterPlayerScripts/ and StarterCharacterScripts/ at the root - NOT nested under StarterPlayer/. Proven by MCP sync probes (tide job 003): the nested form never syncs. Jungle's nested sync/StarterPlayer/... shape is Rojo's convention, not this one. Every path below was OBSERVED, not assumed - re-verified 2026-08-19 after both places were connected, and both places behave identically. Order matters (synced_paths win over non_synced_paths). File suffix sets the class: .luau = ModuleScript, .server.luau = Script/RunContext=Server, .client.luau = Script/RunContext=Client; .module.luau is NOT a recognised suffix.
